jun: Planning a staggered partition attach + index-add for customer_metadata tonight 02:00 UTC. Requesting deploybot pin to schema-v3.1.0 while migration runs. Estimated 90-150m. Any concerns?
rachel: Ack. Which partitions and concurrency?
jun: Monthly partitions 2024-01 -> 2024-06, attach one at a time. concurrency=1, pause_between=45s to let replicas catch up. Index add will be REINDEX CONCURRENTLY on newly attached partitions; expect brief exclusive lock windows (~5-10s) when swapping indexes.
mikael: Suggest abort triggers: p99 DB latency >350ms for >8m OR replica_lag>90s OR more than 4 long lock waits. Also abort if error rate on API >0.5%.
jun: Good. Add API error rate >0.5% to abort. We'll run a canary on partition p2024_01 for 15m before continuing.
deploybot: Pin request accepted. Pinning schema-v3.1.0 for release-group 'custmeta-attach' at 1771002468. Canary: enabled for us-east-1 only. Emitting progress every 10m.
opsbot: Drafted release note at release_notes/1771002468.md: "Attach monthly partitions for customer_metadata (Jan-Jun 2024) and add per-partition index concurrently. Brief exclusive locks during index swap may cause sub-second spikes"
rachel: Rollback/runbook snippets:
```sql
-- emergency stop
UPDATE migration_control SET desired_state='abort' WHERE run_name='custmeta-attach-202402';
-- flip feature flag
UPDATE feature_flags SET value='false' WHERE name='custmeta_attach_enabled';
-- quick unpin (cli)
# deployctl pin --release-group custmeta-attach --unpin
```
mikael: Add monitoring hooks: smoke check after each partition: run `./scripts/smoke_custmeta.sh p2024_01` and fail if >2 errors in 5m. Also post to this thread on failures.
jun: I'll start test partition at 02:05 UTC (5m after window open) to give deploybot time to reconcile pins. If canary passes 15m health checks, proceed sequentially.
deploybot: Test partition run started for p2024_01 at 02:05 UTC. Will report status and metrics.
opsbot: Added abort checklist to thread: 1) run emergency stop SQL 2) run `deployctl pin --unpin` 3) flip feature flag 4) notify oncall and pause remaining partitions.
rachel: I'm oncall and will manual-unpin if needed. Ping me immediately.
jun: Thanks all. I'll post 15m-pings for canary and a final green before continuing
